title: 第336章 禁忌存在人参鬼娃第335章 柳如烟1V4
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: “晚了”
在段家三位长老刚刚反应过来时，柳如烟就早已将幽寒之力输入战雷的体内，并仅仅一息的功夫就侵蚀了战雷的精神识海
战雷整个人一瞬间就变成了冰雕
“妖女！受死吧！”
段炳天见状脸色狰狞的看着柳如烟，战雷乃是段家的供奉大长老，为此他们段家不惜耗费大量资源来帮助修炼，好不容易将战雷的修为提升到大乘巅峰
如今却就这样死在面前，这让他如何接受？
玄煌元塔
轰！
下一刻段炳天祭出一道蕴含天地之力的金色宝塔，此塔总共有九层，此塔一出周围的空间都发生了颤抖，就好像随时都有可能被玄煌元塔散发出的天地之力震碎一般
“不愧是段家最强底蕴至宝之一，当真是恐怖”
一旁的刘文达感受到段炳天祭出来的玄煌元塔，这是他早就听闻段家的巅峰至宝之一，由段炳天掌握
今日所见比传闻还要强大，如果他不是对天地之力有一定的掌握，恐怕他此时也会受到玄煌元塔所散发出来的威压影响
“这是老祖年轻时在一处红尘秘境所得，并炼化为自身的本命至宝，此塔共有九层，每一层内部蕴含着不同层次的威能，其中每一层都有一只强横无比的凶兽，一层比一层强，今日此女必死”
段宏鑫目光灼热的看着段炳天手中的玄煌元塔，心中赌定柳如烟今日必死
玄煌元塔三层齐开！
段炳天身上散发着天地之力和半仙之气，两者相融形成了一股强大的磁场，令周围的空间发生摩擦并产生了细微的空间裂缝
同时段炳天祭出来的玄煌元塔下三层齐齐打开大门，轰的一声每一层内都涌出了一股令人难以承受的威压席卷而出
并且都朝着柳如烟席卷而去，紧接着三头不同实力的凶兽就跑出了玄煌元塔
深海凶兽深渊鬼鲸，雪寒凶兽寒霜雪妖，火炎凶兽大涅妖皇
吼！
很快三头不同的凶兽就显现在众人的面前，实力最低是合体期，最强的是大乘初期，并且肉身比相同境界的人类修士还要强大数倍不止
“妖女，今日老夫就教教你，在没有足够的实力千万不要作死！”
段炳天祭出了下三层的凶兽后，目光放在远处的柳如烟身上，今日不管说什么柳如烟必死，不然难以平息他们段家
同时还要找出此女背后的家族势力
“不过是三只区区鱼啊，雪花啊还有一只火鸡罢了，就这三玩意也想留下我吗？”
柳如烟看着面前三庞然大物的凶兽，眼中丝毫没有惧怕，当初她在来九界的路上见过的星空巨兽可比面前的凶兽大多了
甚至在星空巨兽面前，这三个还不够星空巨兽塞牙缝的
“哼，嘴硬的丫头”
“去，杀了她，老夫还你们自由”
段炳天闻言直接控制面前的三头凶兽朝着柳如烟扑杀而去
吼！
收到指令的凶兽，立马张开血盆大口朝着柳如烟扑杀而去，同时还掀起了周围环境
“来的好，正好让我练习一下近战格斗”
见三头凶兽朝着自己扑来，柳如烟收起了手中的利剑，撸起袖子紧握双拳，并在在拳头上还附加了幽寒之力，保证一拳一只兽
“居然还妄想赤手空拳对抗凶兽，真是无知”
段宏鑫见柳如烟收起利剑，打算赤手空拳对抗三只凶兽，这无疑是痴人说梦，凶兽可不是妖兽，每一只凶兽都是存在几万年的恐怖存在，同时体内还蕴含着上古凶兽的血脉之力，肉身远不是妖兽可比的
更别说人类肉身了，在相同境界的情况下，一只凶兽可随意捏死十个人类
“去死吧，孽畜！”
content_en:
“late”
When the three elders of the Duan family had just reacted, Liu Ruyan had already injected the power of Youhan into Zhan Lei's body, and eroded Zhan Lei's spiritual consciousness in just one breath.
Zhan Lei's whole body turned into an ice sculpture in an instant
"Witch! Die!"
When Duan Bingtian saw this, he looked at Liu Ruyan with a ferocious expression. Zhan Lei was the great elder of the Duan family. For this reason, the Duan family did not hesitate to spend a lot of resources to help with cultivation, and finally raised Zhan Lei's cultivation to the peak of Mahayana.
Now he died like this in front of him, how could he accept it?
Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda
Boom!
The next moment, Duan Bingtian sacrificed a golden pagoda containing the power of heaven and earth. This tower had nine floors in total. The space around the tower trembled as soon as it came out, as if it might be shattered at any time by the power of heaven and earth emanating from the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda.
"It is indeed one of the most powerful treasures of the Duan family. It is really terrifying."
Liu Wenda on the side felt the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda sacrificed by Duan Bingtian. He had long heard that it was one of the top treasures of the Duan family and was controlled by Duan Bingtian.
What he saw today was even more powerful than the rumors. If he didn't have a certain grasp of the power of heaven and earth, I'm afraid he would also be affected by the coercion emanating from the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda at this time.
"This is what my ancestor obtained in a secret realm of the world of mortals when he was young, and refined it into his own natal treasure. This tower has nine floors, and each floor contains different levels of power. Each floor has an extremely powerful and ferocious beast. Each floor is stronger than the next. This woman will die today."
Duan Hongxin looked at the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda in Duan Bingtian's hand with burning eyes, betting in his heart that Liu Ruyan would die today.
The three floors of Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda are opened at the same time!
Duan Bingtian exudes the power of heaven and earth and the aura of a semi-immortal. The two merge to form a strong magnetic field, which causes friction in the surrounding space and creates tiny spatial cracks.
At the same time, the doors on the lower three floors of the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda that Duan Bingtian sacrificed opened in unison. With a bang, an unbearable pressure surged out from each floor.
And they all swept towards Liu Ruyan, and then three ferocious beasts of different strengths ran out of the Xuanhuang Yuan Tower.
The ferocious beast of the deep sea, the abyss ghost whale, the ferocious beast of snow and cold, the frost snow demon, the ferocious beast of fire, the Great Nirvana Demon Emperor
Roar!
Soon three different ferocious beasts appeared in front of everyone. The lowest strength was in the combined stage, and the strongest was in the early stage of Mahayana. Their bodies were several times stronger than human monks in the same realm.
"Witch, I will teach you today, never seek death if you don't have enough strength!"
After Duan Bingtian sacrificed the ferocious beasts on the lower three floors, he focused on Liu Ruyan in the distance. No matter what he said today, Liu Ruyan would die, otherwise it would be difficult to calm down the Duan family.
At the same time, we need to find out the family power behind this woman.
"It's just three fish, a snowflake, and a turkey. Do you want to keep me even with these three things?"
Liu Ruyan looked at the three huge ferocious beasts in front of her, with no fear in her eyes. The starry sky beasts she had seen on the way to the Nine Realms were much larger than the ferocious beasts in front of her.
Even in front of the giant starry sky beast, these three are not enough to fill the teeth of the giant starry sky beast.
"Hmph, a tough-tongued girl."
"Go, kill her, and I will set you free."
Upon hearing this, Duan Bingtian directly controlled the three ferocious beasts in front of him and rushed towards Liu Ruyan.
Roar!
After receiving the order, the ferocious beast immediately opened its bloody mouth and rushed towards Liu Ruyan, while also causing a stir in the surrounding environment.
"You're good to go, just in time for me to practice some melee combat."
Seeing the three ferocious beasts rushing towards him, Liu Ruyan put away the sharp sword in his hand, rolled up his sleeves and clenched his fists, and added the power of coldness to his fists to ensure that one punch would kill the beast.
"You actually want to fight against the beast with your bare hands, you are really ignorant."
Duan Hongxin saw Liu Ruyan put away the sword and planned to fight three ferocious beasts with bare hands. This was undoubtedly a fool's dream. The ferocious beasts were not monsters. Each ferocious beast was a terrifying existence that had existed for tens of thousands of years. At the same time, the body also contained the power of the blood of ancient ferocious beasts. The physical body was far from comparable to the monster beasts.
Not to mention the human body. Under the same conditions, a ferocious beast can crush ten humans to death at will.
"Go to hell, you bastard!"
